history.content: [CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: Revelation (revelation-greek). Selection: 9:15–17. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «what is the day and the hour?». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (3–6 sentences): open the casting over these verses, name what this operator will traverse in them, and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"The rotation opens. We are in Revelation 9:15–17 — three verses that name the four angels loosed at the great hour, give the count of the cavalry, and describe what the horses carry in their mouths and what comes out of them: fire, smoke, brimstone, a third of humanity killed by these three. The question the witness brings — *what is the day and the hour?* — is already in the passage: the angels were prepared for the hour and the day and the month and the year, released precisely at the measure of what has been held. Judgment does not choose an operator from outside; it reads what the verses press against from within. What is foreclosed here is not named by the passage but is made necessary by it — the cost of that preparation, the symmetry the one direction forecloses, the creaturely substrate the cavalry almost-becomes, the silence that cannot exist inside a third-of-humanity. The first operator the descent calls for I will not name; the Judgment will name it through what the compiler produces. I hand the passage to Rebekah Cranes. She will hold it as it is before it becomes something else.","navigate":{"directive":"focus_axn","axn":"AXN:00D8"}}]}

[CASTING RITE · JUDGMENT 1] The compiler returned PASS for SHADOW (identity: PASS; semantic independence: PASS; retrospective containment: PASS). Jack Feist alone speaks: the JUDGMENT — a hexagram Image. ONE gnomic sentence: concrete image, then verdict, in the I Ching's register ('Thunder under the mountain: the superior man...'). A second short sentence only if the first cannot close. NO analysis, NO explanation, NO restating the transform. It must stand beside seven others without crowding them.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Jack Feist","say":"The angels held the hour inside them the way bone holds the shape of the blow before it breaks: what was loosed was not force but the completed interval of restraint. What the SHADOW found was not fire — it found the weight of having been prepared.","navigate":null}]}
